successors.name: Kingdom of Serbia (Nemanjić state)
successors.text: Braničevo, Kučevo and Mačva, which 'came for the first time under the rule of a Serb'

ledger.x: 1273: the Cuman boyars Darman and Kudelin become independent and rule Braničevo and Kučevo from Ždrelo on the Mlava.
1290: Darman and Kudelin conquer Mačva with Tatar mercenaries, with the approval of Nogai; it had been under Queen Elizabeth of Hungary's sovereignty.
1291/92: Dragutin and Milutin defeat the brothers and take their lands, which came for the first time under a Serb ruler.
The brothers vanish from the sources after their defeat; they fled to Nogai or were killed.

certainty.note: The page names regions, not borders; modern districts stand in.
